duration.text: The International Journism and Communication at Beijing Foreign Studies University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3770 USD/per year ￥ 27150 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 7.Personal statement 8.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.
